questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「值得的」？
questions.explain: worth 的意思是值得的。

questions.stem: 「budget」的中文意思是哪一个？
questions.explain: budget 的意思是预算。

questions.stem: 包已经不在桌上。她当时一定是带走了。哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 对过去的肯定推测用 must have taken。

questions.stem: 他当时本可以求助，却没有。哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 本来可以做却没做，用 could have asked。
options: He could ask for help yesterday now
He could has asked for help
He could have asked for help

questions.stem: 我宁愿你现在把真相告诉我。哪一句正确？
questions.explain: would rather 从句表示与现在相反时用过去式 told。
options: I would rather you tell me the truth now
I would rather you to tell me
I would rather you had tell me now
I would rather you told me the truth now

questions.stem: 哪一句表示宁愿自己当时没买？
questions.explain: 与过去事实相反用 had not bought。
options: I would rather I had not bought it
I would rather I did not bought it
I would rather not buying it yesterday
I would rather I buy it not

questions.stem: 想说这件便宜货不值得买，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: worth 后面接 buying。
options: This bargain is not worth buying
This bargain is not worth to buy
This bargain are not worth buying

questions.stem: 想推测钱包一定是落在公交车上了，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 对过去的推测用 must have left。
options: You must leave the wallet on the bus yesterday
You must have left the wallet on the bus
You must had left the wallet
Must have you left the wallet

questions.stem: Tom bought a coat because it looked like a bargain. Later he found a hole in it. His sister said he should have checked the pockets and kept to his budget. Tom 为什么买那件外套？
questions.explain: 短文写 it looked like a bargain。

questions.stem: Tom bought a coat because it looked like a bargain. Later he found a hole in it. His sister said he should have checked the pockets and kept to his budget. 后来他发现了什么？
questions.explain: 短文写 a hole。

questions.stem: 要点：看起来便宜、后来有洞、当时该检查。哪一句三个要点都有？
questions.explain: 三个要点都要出现。
options: It looked like a bargain, but there was a hole, and I should have checked it

questions.stem: 反思里表示当时不该借款，哪一句正确？
questions.explain: should not have taken 表示本不该借。
options: I should not took the loan
I should not have take the loan
I must not to have take
I should not have taken the loan

questions.stem: 选择表示「贷款」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示贷款的单词是 loan。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「便宜货」？
questions.explain: bargain 的意思是便宜货。

questions.stem: 选择表示「债务」的单词。
questions.explain: 表示债务的单词是 debt。

questions.stem: 哪个单词的意思是「慈善机构」？
questions.explain: charity 的意思是慈善机构。

questions.stem: 你当时不该借那么多钱。哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 本不该做用 should not have borrowed。
options: You should not have borrowed so much
You should not borrowed so much
You should not have borrow so much
You must not to have borrowed

questions.stem: 哪一句表示对过去没有把握的推测？
questions.explain: could have been lost 是对过去可能性的推测。
options: The wallet must be on the bus now
The wallet could have been lost on the bus

questions.stem: She would rather ___ at home than go out. 横线处填哪一个？
questions.explain: would rather 后面直接接原形时用 stay than go。

questions.stem: 哪一句用了从句里的过去式？
questions.explain: you came 是从句里的过去式，表示愿望。
options: I would rather to come tomorrow
I would rather you came tomorrow
I rather would you to come

questions.stem: 想建议先做预算再借钱，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: 建议用 You should make a budget。
options: You should have make a budget tomorrow
You should maked a budget before you take a loan
You should make a budget before you take a loan
You should to make a budget before you take a loan

questions.stem: 想说明把一部分钱捐给慈善更有价值，哪一句合适？
questions.explain: is of greater value 用来比较价值。
options: Giving some money to charity are of greater value
Give some money to charity is of greater value
Giving some money to charrity is of greater value
Giving some money to charity is of greater value

questions.stem: Tom bought a coat because it looked like a bargain. Later he found a hole in it. His sister said he should have checked the pockets and kept to his budget. 姐姐认为他当时应该做什么？
questions.explain: 短文写 should have checked the pockets and kept to his budget。

questions.stem: Tom bought a coat because it looked like a bargain. Later he found a hole in it. His sister said he should have checked the pockets and kept to his budget. 哪一句和短文一致？
questions.explain: should have checked 表示当时该做却没做。
options: He should have checked the coat
He must check the coat tomorrow in the past

questions.stem: 哪一句适合作为反思的第一句？
questions.explain: 反思开头可以写 I learned a lesson。
options: I learned a lesson about value
I learned an lesson about value
I learning a lesson about value
I leerned a lesson about value

questions.stem: 宁愿当时没买，哪一句正确？
questions.explain: 与过去事实相反用 had not bought。
options: I would rather I did not bought the coat
I would rather I had not bought the coat
I would rather not buying the coat yesterday
